slides.headline: Five places to start closing the gap with [[readers]].
Invest much, much more in understanding your audience.
slides.text: Talk to them, show them new ideas, run diary studies. Listen, implement, then listen some more.

slides.headline: Bring novel ideas to the table.
slides.text: Every news website is a variation on a theme: a headline, a picture and some body copy. Let's be inventors.

slides.headline: Play the infinite game.
slides.text: Be something very important to a distinct audience, rather than something of marginal value to everyone.

slides.headline: Consider everything on the table.
slides.text: What you cover, how you cover it. Workflow, formats, volume. All of it needs to be examined.

slides.headline: Design an experience.
slides.text: From the first moment someone discovers you to the moment they pause or cancel: considered, easy, respectful.

slides.headline: What would you do differently?
slides.text: Read the full piece, and get the next one by email.
